title: Identification of New Lupane-Type Triterpenoids as Inverse Agonists of RAR-Related Orphan Receptor Gamma (RORgamma).
authors: Schwarz, Patrik F; Perhal, Alexander F; Guder, Famke; Hernandez Gonzalez, Jorge Enrique; Janssen, Kerrin; Sagiroglu, Ece; Tahir, Ammar; Kirchmair, Johannes; Rochel, Natacha; Dirsch, Verena M; Chen, Ya
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小分子配体与核受体RORgamma的相互作用，属于蛋白-小分子体系，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Targeting retinoic acid-related orphan receptor gamma (RORgamma) with inverse agonists presents a promising therapeutic strategy for treating autoimmune diseases, including psoriasis, rheumatoid arthritis, and multiple sclerosis. Through structure-based virtual screening, we identified a lupane-type pentacyclic triterpenoid, (2Z)-2-(2-furanylmethylene)-3-oxolup-20(29)-en-28-oic acid (15), as a new inverse agonist of RORgamma. The compound exhibited IC(50) values of 0.4 muM and 0.9 muM in Gal4-RORgamma and full-length RORgamma luciferase assays, respectively. Compound 15 showed improved potency and efficacy compared to a structurally related known inverse agonist, betulinic acid. Among the four additional analogues tested (15.1-15.4), two (15.2 and 15.3) also demonstrated RORgamma inverse agonist activity with low micromolar IC(50) values in Gal4-RORgamma luciferase assay. Real-time quantitative polymerase chain reaction experiments confirmed that compounds 15, 15.2, and 15.3 downregulated RORgamma target genes. Thermal shift assays showed that both betulinic acid and 15 stabilized the RORgamma ligand-binding domain. Molecular docking and structure-activity relationship analysis revealed distinct binding modes within the RORgamma ligand-binding domains, further supported by site-directed mutagenesis. These findings expand the repertoire of RORgamma inverse agonists based on the pentacyclic triterpenoid scaffolds.
abstract_zh: 以反向激动剂靶向维甲酸相关孤儿受体γ（RORgamma）为治疗自身免疫性疾病（包括银屑病、类风湿性关节炎和多发性硬化症）提供了一种有前景的治疗策略。通过基于结构的虚拟筛选，我们鉴定出一种羽扇豆烷型五环三萜类化合物，(2Z)-2-(2-呋喃亚甲基)-3-氧代羽扇豆-20(29)-烯-28-酸（15），作为RORgamma的新型反向激动剂。该化合物在Gal4-RORgamma和全长RORgamma荧光素酶实验中分别表现出0.4 μM和0.9 μM的IC(50)值。与结构相关的已知反向激动剂桦木酸相比，化合物15显示出更高的效力和效能。在测试的四种额外类似物（15.1-15.4）中，两种（15.2和15.3）在Gal4-RORgamma荧光素酶实验中也表现出低微摩尔IC(50)值的RORgamma反向激动剂活性。实时定量聚合酶链反应实验证实，化合物15、15.2和15.3下调了RORgamma靶基因。热位移实验表明，桦木酸和15均稳定了RORgamma配体结合域。分子对接和结构-活性关系分析揭示了RORgamma配体结合域内的不同结合模式，并得到定点突变的进一步支持。这些发现扩展了基于五环三萜骨架的RORgamma反向激动剂库。
